subject: gk
question: Which of the following is a public sector industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BHEL**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Public sector industries:-**

 
 
• These are those that are owned and operated by the government.
 
• BHEL (Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited) is a public sector company that specializes in manufacturing electrical equipment.
 
 
 
• **BHEL:-**
 
 
• It is a public sector industry.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dabur Industry:-**

 
 
• It is a private sector company that specializes in manufacturing Ayurvedic medicine and consumer goods. 
 
 
 
• **Bajaj Auto:-**
 
 
• It is a private sector company that specializes in manufacturing two-wheelers and three-wheelers.
 
 
 
• **TISCO:-**
 
 
• It is a private sector company that specializes in manufacturing steel products.
